'''Belsavis''', also known as '''Plawal''',<ref name="TEGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ninth Quadrant]], a region of the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]]. Ice-covered, its average temperature was in the -50s. It was located on the edge of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], at one end of the [[Belsavis Run]].

==History==
===Pre- and Old Republic eras===
{{Quote|What I saw... I don't think we were the first ones on this planet.|Marshall Cavarat|<ref name="TOR" />}}
At one point in history, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] became one of the many worlds that belonged to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. During that time, the Rakata made use of the world as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony, where they placed many [[Esh-kha|dangerous prisoners]] that remained trapped for the millennia. It entered an ice age around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Its inhabitants dwelt in three [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] jungle rifts. Later, during the [[Great Galactic War]], the Republic used Belsavis' prison, [[The Tomb]], to confine dangerous [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords and war criminals. By the beginning of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] discovered Belsavis' location from the imprisoned crime lord, [[Ivory]], through use of a Rakata transmitter, and sought to perform a mass [[Invasion of Belsavis|prison break]], including freeing the imprisoned [[Dread Masters]] and discovering Rakata secrets. At the same time, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] dispatched Executor [[Krannus]] to destroy Belsavis, which would have sent shockwaves into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] that would have destroyed adjacent systems, fulfilling the Emperor's intended galactic genocide. It was only through the [[Mission to Belsavis (Emperor's ritual crisis)|intervention]] of the [[Hero of Tython]] that Belsavis was saved.<ref name="TOR" />

A community by the name of [[Plett's Well]] was settled in [[88 BBY/Legends|88 BBY]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]], and came to be called simply Plawal. The main [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] colonization of the planet occurred in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], with many plants and animals being imported from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
[[File:BelsavisSurface-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Settlements on the icy surface of Belsavis]]
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was once captured and imprisoned in an underground labyrinth on Belsavis. Although pursued by [[kretch insect]]s, he managed to escape by figuring out the internal logic of the maze.<ref name="Boba Fett: Maze of Deception">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>

===Imperial era===
Later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Plett hid a number of [[Children of the Jedi|Jedi younglings]] in Plett's Well from the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], but the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' to bombard Plawal. Fortunately, Jedi Knights [[Callista Ming]] and [[Geith Eris]] sabotaged the ''Eye'', but Plett and the Jedi younglings were forced to flee the planet regardless. Some of the younglings, such as [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]], were captured by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. Around [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] stationed a few tariff police on the world to deal with increased [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] activity. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Brathflen Corporation]] and other fruit-companies established domes around the world. At the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the world to investigate the rumors of the Jedi fugitives.<ref name="CotJ" />

===New Republic era===
In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], a large shipment of [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle|Tenloss Disintegrator rifles]] was to be shipped to Belsavis, but the cargo was stolen on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[New Republic Intelligence/Legends|New Republic Intelligence Service]] was informed of the theft, but were unsure why the munitions were heading there in the first place.<ref name="N.R.I. Reports">{{LucasArts|url=products/outcast/html/spin.html|text=N.R.I. Reports|int=N.R.I. Reports}}</ref>

The planet allied with, but did not join, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], maintaining independence. Later in 12 ABY, Roganda Ismaren later attempted a [[Ismaren plot|coup]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on Belsavis, attempting to make her son [[Irek Ismaren]] the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] with financial backing from treacherous nobles from the neighboring [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] and Senex sector, along with using Irek's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] to control the ''Eye''. Roganda was foiled by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Callista, and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="CotJ" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] agent advised Leia Organa and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] that the Senex and Juvex sectors, including Belsavis, had fallen to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] amidst a widespread communications blackout.<ref name="Heretic">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We found Belsavis, and the Holocron said it's a giant ice planet with volcanic craters that create jungle areas deep in enormous shafts in the middle of this ice world. I thought, ''OK, we're using'' that ''world!''|Daniel Erickson|<ref name="The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]], Belsavis is a cheat code. Also, the article ''The Emperor's Pawns'' misspelled this planet "Belsalvis" on one occasion.
